mission: Write the ratified positive Verdict and Beep counterpart values into the Notion @beep/semantica atlas from a schema-validated verdicts file (atlas-verdicts/v1) through the P5 method (render, diff against a live 33-catalog read, one canary write, apply, SQL read-back) on exactly the rows the file lists and with zero Notion schema; the IR facts lane stays a gated P2 on semantica 0.6.7+ (MAP v1.1 section A, R3).

provenance.note: MAP v1.1 re-entry packet A (DECISIONS 2026-09-03 R3, ratified with R3.a-R3.g and the Verdict-map cell R3.f). Fired by the atlas-edit need the canary's P5 closeout left (2026-09-02: four rows declined for lack of positive vocabulary); D5 is split into a verdict lane (P1, now) and a facts lane (P2, gated on the O3 version trigger, semantica 0.6.7+, unverified as of 2026-09-03). The repo is the single writer of decision facts (A9).

completionGate.statement: Not achieved until this goal's work ships as a PR driven to mergeable via /yeet (bun run beep yeet: repair -> verify -> publish --pr -> monitor).

stopConditions: Notion access is not live-verified: re-check the connection (a read of one catalog) before the one canary write; a failed read stops the lane before any write.
A write to any row not enumerated in research/atlas/verdicts.json; any new Notion row, property, or schema; a positive Verdict without its Beep counterpart in the same write (R3.b, R3.c, R3.e).
An already-have record without a dated, row-specific entry in explorations/semantica-lab/DECISIONS.md naming its shipped @beep/* counterpart; package existence alone is never a verdict (R3.d, D7).
Family vocabulary (pick-one, bundle, park-pending-canary) reaching the atlas, or a positive value for a family whose canary stage has not passed (B1).
The facts lane (P2) starting before semantica 0.6.7+ ships (the firing recorded in a dated DECISIONS entry); deciding the extractor's home outside that lane (R3.g).
Notion page identifiers, machine paths, or session ids in committed packet data (review-loop law, 2026-08-24).
Verification requires credentials, cost, destructive side effects, or policy approval not named in SPEC.md.
The same blocker repeats after reasonable investigation.
statusNote: Scaffolded 2026-09-03 at the semantica-lab graduation ceremony (MAP v1.1 §A, R3); execution not started. Runs first of the three re-entry packets: P0 access check + live 33-catalog baseline, then the P1 verdict lane; P2 (facts lane) is gated on semantica 0.6.7+; if the gate has not fired when P1 ships, the P1 PR itself sets the packet paused (same-PR state flip).
